description: Discover tickers filtered by type (equity, ETF, mutual fund, index, future, currency, cryptocurrency).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

lang.description: Target language for translated text fields (BCP 47, e.g. "ja", "zh-Hant"); English or omitted = no translation

logo.description: Include logo URLs (requires an additional upstream API call); default: false

query.description: Search query (company name or ticker symbol)

name: lookup
title: Ticker Lookup by Type
